```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# 提取结果
res <- params$results
plan <- params$plan
theme <- params$theme_obj

# 使用 .core 包的格式化函数
.format_p <- function(p, context = "table") {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  iQualityR.core::format_p_value(p, context = context)
}
```

# ANOVA Analysis Report

## 1. 模型信息

- **任务类型**: `r res$test_type %||% "ANOVA"`
- **模型公式**: `r res$formula %||% ""`
- **样本量**: `r res$n %||% NA`
- **分析时间**: `r format(params$timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')`

## 2. 方差分析表

```{r anova_table}
if (!is.null(res$anova_table)) {
  df <- cbind(Source = rownames(res$anova_table), res$anova_table)
  if ("Pr(>F)" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Sig <- sapply(df$`Pr(>F)`, function(p) .format_p(p, "table"))
  }
  kable(df, digits = 4, caption = "ANOVA Table") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else if (!is.null(res$anova_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(res$anova_tables)) {
    cat("\n### ", nm, "\n\n")
    df <- cbind(Source = rownames(res$anova_tables[[nm]]), res$anova_tables[[nm]])
    kable(df, digits = 4, caption = paste("ANOVA Table -", nm)) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
  }
}
```

## 3. 模型摘要

```{r model_summary}
if (!is.null(res$summary)) {
  summ <- res$summary
  cat("**R-squared**:", round(summ$r.squared, 4), "\n")
  cat("**Adj R-squared**:", round(summ$adj.r.squared, 4), "\n")
  if (!is.null(summ$fstatistic)) {
    f_p <- pf(summ$fstatistic[1], summ$fstatistic[2], summ$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
    cat("**F-statistic**:", round(summ$fstatistic[1], 2),
        "on", summ$fstatistic[2], "and", summ$fstatistic[3], "DF,",
        "p-value:", .format_p(f_p, "table"), "\n")
  }
}
```

## 4. 效应量

```{r effect_size}
if (!is.null(res$effect_size)) {
  if (!is.null(res$effect_size$eta)) {
    cat("**Eta-squared (η²)**:\n")
    df <- data.frame(Effect = names(res$effect_size$eta), η² = round(res$effect_size$eta, 4))
    kable(df, digits = 4, caption = "Eta-squared") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
  }
  if (!is.null(res$effect_size$partial_eta)) {
    cat("\n**Partial Eta-squared (ηp²)**:\n")
    df <- data.frame(Effect = names(res$effect_size$partial_eta), ηp² = round(res$effect_size$partial_eta, 4))
    kable(df, digits = 4, caption = "Partial Eta-squared") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
  }
}
```

## 5. 多重比较

```{r multiple_comparisons}
if (!is.null(res$multiple_comparisons)) {
  if (is.data.frame(res$multiple_comparisons)) {
    df <- res$multiple_comparisons
    if ("p.value" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$Sig <- sapply(df$p.value, function(p) .format_p(p, "table"))
    }
    kable(df, digits = 4, caption = "Multiple Comparisons (Tukey HSD)") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
  } else if (is.list(res$multiple_comparisons)) {
    for (nm in names(res$multiple_comparisons)) {
      cat("\n### ", nm, "\n\n")
      df <- res$multiple_comparisons[[nm]]
      if (is.data.frame(df)) {
        kable(df, digits = 4, caption = paste("Multiple Comparisons -", nm)) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 6. 诊断图

```{r diagnostic_plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (inherits(res$model, "lm")) {
  # 使用基础 R 绘制残差诊断图
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
  plot(res$model)
}
```

## 7. 解释与建议

```{r interpretation, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(res$test_type)) {
  cat("### 统计结论\n")
  if (!is.null(res$anova_table)) {
    p_val <- res$anova_table[1, "Pr(>F)"]
    sig <- if (p_val < 0.001) "极显著" else if (p_val < 0.01) "非常显著" else if (p_val < 0.05) "显著" else "不显著"
    cat(sprintf("- %s 检验结果为 %s (F = %.2f, df = %d, %d, p = %s)。\n",
                res$test_type, sig,
                res$anova_table[1, "F value"],
                res$anova_table[1, "Df"],
                res$anova_table[2, "Df"],
                .format_p(p_val, "plot")))
  }
  if (!is.null(res$effect_size$eta)) {
    cat("\n### 效应量\n")
    eta <- res$effect_size$eta[1]
    desc <- if (eta >= 0.14) "大效应" else if (eta >= 0.06) "中效应" else "小效应"
    cat(sprintf("- 因素解释了 %.1f%% 的总变异（η² = %.3f），属于 %s。\n", eta * 100, eta, desc))
  }
}
```
